messages.subject: chain "freezes" after adaptation
parts:
I have an IRT model with priors that are a bit too vague
to identify it well in the posterior. I fit using
RStan 1.3 and all the traceplots look like the one attached.
This one is 2000 iterations, but after adaptation ends,
the chain gets relatively frozen.

This one's for the intercept (equivalently hierarchical
mean), and it should have a value of around 1.0.

(As an aside, I reran the model for 5K iterations and everything
was fine, though the posterior intervals were very fat.)

Did perhaps a round of adaptation kick in at 1000 iterations to
reduce the step size dramatically?

Daniel was seeing identical kinds of behavior on a very different
model. Everything appeared to be mixing during warmup, then
adaptation ends, and bang, a frozen chain. (Daniel ran 4 chains
and 3 of them were OK.)

This is an issue that looks like a computational issue. It's not
like it's frozen way out in some mode somewhere.

I haven't tested in 2.0, but I'm hoping the new adaptation will be a
bit better behaved.

- Bob
